avoid_when: Fresh inspection of the same candidate already answers the question.
The current candidate only needs authoritative compilation or final verification.
expected_outputs: Source-hashed tactic states before/after execution, local context, source positions, term types when available, diagnostics and explicit partial/unavailable status.
role_goal: Observe the current Lean candidate at tactic and error positions: goals, local hypotheses, expected/actual types and placeholder locations, without changing or certifying the proof.
use_when: A failure requires understanding the actual local goal or typeclass context at a source position.
A candidate has unclear intermediate goals or a type mismatch not resolved by existing evidence.

avoid_when: The needed lemma and candidate proof are already explicit.
expected_outputs: Candidate lemmas or premises and why their types match the visible goal.
role_goal: Identify applicable visible hypotheses and Mathlib lemmas without claiming that a proof has compiled.
use_when: The goal requires selecting a lemma or transformation not evident from current state.
A compiler failure indicates a missing or mismatched lemma.

avoid_when: An unchanged candidate is awaiting compilation.
A failed candidate first needs diagnosis rather than blind regeneration.
expected_outputs: An executor-authored candidate proof, not a success claim.
role_goal: Construct a candidate Lean proof from the current goal and available evidence.
use_when: The theorem is incomplete and no candidate proof exists.
A different proof strategy is justified by new evidence.

avoid_when: The current candidate has not yet been compiled.
expected_outputs: A revised candidate tied to the concrete diagnostic.
role_goal: Revise a failed Lean candidate using the latest compiler diagnostic while preserving the theorem statement.
use_when: A candidate proof has a concrete compiler failure.
New feedback supports a materially revised candidate.

avoid_when: The unchanged candidate already has a fresh compiler result.
expected_outputs: Kernel/compiler exit status and exact public diagnostics.
role_goal: Compile the current candidate in the packet's pinned Lean and Mathlib environment.
use_when: A candidate exists without a fresh compiler result.
The candidate changed after the previous compilation.

expected_outputs: Terminal-contract evidence for theorem identity, placeholders and assumptions.
role_goal: Verify that a compiled theorem closes without forbidden placeholders or added assumptions.
use_when: The candidate compiles and terminal compliance still needs confirmation.

avoid_when: No compiler or proof failure is visible.
The current candidate only needs compilation.
expected_outputs: A diagnosis grounded in the visible goal and compiler feedback.
role_goal: Explain a concrete Lean compiler or proof failure and identify evidence-grounded repair constraints.
use_when: Repeated candidates fail without substantive progress.
